title: cynanchum rostellatum
intro: Cynanchum rostellatum, commonly known as the "Rattlesnake Plant," is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is a climbing vine native to East Asia, known for its medicinal properties and traditional use in herbal medicine. The plant is said to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, and its therapeutic actions include vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Cynanchum rostellatum include iridoid glycosides, such as aucubin and catalpol, which are believed to be responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
